trial_court: Family Court, Aurangabad, Petition No. 73 of 2003
case_name: Vandana J. Kasliwal vs Jitendra N. Kasliwal
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 5-1-2003. The respondent filed petition for annulment citing abnormal behaviour by the appellant. The trial court passed a decree annulling the marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging fraud to prove it.
legal_principles.held: It is also argued before us that sofar as the so called suspicion and torture because of the talk of the appellant/wife with her cousin brother on telephone is concerned, it will have to be considered whether it was a plausible and reasonable explanation.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider whether the version given by a party can be accepted.
legal_principles.held: We have to consider whether this version can be accepted.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the probability of a reason given by a party.
legal_principles.held: It is improbable that within such a short period there will be any lust for money and that the money could be the reason for filing the petition.

outcome.final_order: The final court order annulled the marriage as per the decree of the trial court.

use_for_drafting: drafting petition for annulment of marriage
